title: Important Industrial Locations
definition: The spatial distribution and geographical clustering of manufacturing, processing, and heavy industrial units driven by raw material availability, transport logistics, energy sources, market proximity, and government policy.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims via map-based questions on mineral belts, port-based industries, and specialized manufacturing hubs, and in Mains (GS Paper 1 & 3) regarding factors influencing industrial location, regional imbalances, and corridor economics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Important Industrial Locations.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Mineral and Energy Resources of India
